intro.title: Websites Designed to Grow Your Business
paragraphs: Your website is often the first impression a customer has of your business. In a few seconds it has to explain what you do, build trust and make it easy to get in touch or buy. A slow, outdated or hard-to-use website quietly loses customers to competitors every day.

As a full-service web design and development company, we plan, design, build and look after websites that do their job: clear messaging, a modern look that reflects your brand, fast loading on every phone, and contact forms, WhatsApp buttons and calls to action in the right places. Every site is responsive, secure and built with search engine optimisation in mind, so customers can find you on Google.

We are an India-based team of web designers and developers working with clients across India and worldwide. You get one team for design, development, content, SEO, hosting and maintenance, with transparent pricing. Need more than a website, such as a portal or online platform? See our <webapp>web application development</webapp> or <contact>tell us about your project</contact>.

faqs.title: Web Design FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers about website design and development.

items.q: How much does it cost to design and develop a website?
items.a: A starter website for a small business typically costs $800 to $2,500, a custom business website $2,500 to $8,000, and ecommerce sites or portals from $8,000. The price depends on pages, design, features and content.

items.q: How long does it take to build a website?
items.a: A starter website usually takes 2 to 3 weeks, a business website 3 to 6 weeks, and ecommerce or portal projects 6 weeks or more, depending on content readiness and feedback.

items.q: Will my website be mobile-friendly and SEO-friendly?
items.a: Yes. Every website is responsive and mobile-first, optimised for speed, and built with on-page SEO, schema markup, a sitemap and Search Console setup so it is ready to rank on Google.

items.q: Can I update the website content myself?
items.a: Yes. We build websites on an easy content management system, so you can edit text, images, blog posts and products yourself, and we provide training.

items.q: Do you provide hosting and website maintenance?
items.a: Yes. We offer managed hosting, SSL, daily backups, security updates and monthly maintenance plans, plus ongoing SEO services if you want to grow traffic.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside your city?
items.a: Yes. We are an India-based web design and development company working with clients across India and worldwide. Everything is handled online with calls in your time zone, so location is never a barrier.
